status_effects.explanation: His testimony against Bergotte is partly discounted when both parents note he is not always benevolent toward people outside his own circle, a mild local dent to his credibility despite the accompanying praise of his kindness.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Norpois est tout ce qu'il y a de plus gentil, mais il n'est pas toujours très bienveillant, surtout pour les gens qui ne sont pas de son bord. » – « C'est vrai, je l'avais aussi remarqué, répondit mon père. »
appraisal_events.explanation: Right after Norpois's disparaging word about Bergotte is invoked as authority, the mother calls him kind but not always fair to outsiders, and the father agrees, mildly discounting his reliability as a judge.
